issues.legal_issue: A year-to-year lease used for a process that transforms a commodity into a distinct product is for a manufacturing purpose, so a short termination notice is invalid.
material_facts: The tenant held open land under a lease and used it only to operate a flour mill.
The tenant's receipts showed that rent was paid yearly.
The mill used labour and machinery to transform wheat into flour, which had a different name and use from wheat.
The landlord sought eviction after giving one month's notice.
issues.conclusion: The lease was from year to year and for a manufacturing purpose, so the one-month notice was invalid and the eviction suit failed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act, a lease for manufacturing purposes is terminable only by six months' notice. Applying the popular and dictionary meaning of manufacturing in Allenburry Engineers Private Ltd. v. Ramakrishna Dalmia, and the authorities South Bihar Sugar Mills v. Union of India and Union of India v. Delhi Cloth and General Mills, manufacture requires production of a commodity through labour or machinery and transformation into an end product with a different name and use. Joyanti Hosiery Mills v. Upendra Chandra Das and John Augustine Peter Mirande v. N. Datha Naik were also approved. The tenant bears the burden of proving that the lease was for a manufacturing purpose.

rule.if: civil_eviction_appeal and annual_lease and short_termination_notice_given and distinct_commodity_produced and production_used_labor_or_machinery and end_product_has_different_name_and_use

predicates.civil_eviction_appeal: The case is an appeal concerning a suit to evict a tenant from leased property.
predicates.annual_lease: The tenant's rent receipts showed that rent was paid yearly.
predicates.short_termination_notice_given: The landlord gave notice to terminate the tenancy that was shorter than the notice required for the kind of lease at issue.
predicates.distinct_commodity_produced: The tenant's activity produced a commodity from the material being processed.
predicates.production_used_labor_or_machinery: The production process used labour or machinery.
predicates.end_product_has_different_name_and_use: The resulting product had a different name and use from the material before processing.

issues.definition: When an eviction appeal concerns a yearly lease terminated by a short notice, and the tenant's process produces a commodity using labour or machinery that has a different name and use from the input, the eviction suit fails.
